# Dashboard access requires sign-in You can also investigate this project using the Vercel CLI. The commands below require a CLI session with access to the project. If you don't have the CLI installed, run: ```sh npm i -g vercel ``` Sign in with `vc login` if needed. ## Runtime Logs ### Query recent Runtime Logs ```sh vc logs --scope deployments --project systemdesignschool.io --since 30m --json ```
